Gwen Morse (gold...@geocities.com) wrote>
> Does a vampire come out of Torpor tapped or untapped. Does it come out
> able to perform actions that same turn or not?

> Somewhat related. Can a vampire with blood tap and transfer blood to a
> vamp at 0 blood (or at any less than full capacity)? Can they transfer
> retainers (if they both fulfill the retainer requirements)? I think I've
> only seen mention of equipment in the rules, but someone I played
> against wanted me to ask about blood and retainers.

Not without a card.

Actions that can be taken without the use of a card are listed
in the rules.
